title: Japanese Miso Egg Custard
description: A rich and creamy egg custard infused with the savory flavor of miso, perfect for a light dinner or snack.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the egg and miso until well combined.
Pour the egg mixture into 2 small ramekins or custard cups.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the ramekins from the baking dish and let cool for a few minutes.
Garnish with roasted miso powder and a sprinkle of revive powder, if desired.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
